name: P17 follower hop from distance travelled

steps.note: 1. Stand still — monster modelT / hop should barely advance (idle breathe only).

steps.eval: (async()=>{ const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const mon=()=>(__DQ.state().companions.followers||[]).find(f=>f.kind==='monster')||(__DQ.state().companions.followers||[])[0]; const a=mon(); window.__still0={id:a&&a.id, walked:a&&a.walked, rate:a&&a.rate, x:a&&a.x, z:a&&a.z}; await sleep(1200); const b=mon(); window.__still1={id:b&&b.id, walked:b&&b.walked, rate:b&&b.rate, x:b&&b.x, z:b&&b.z, speed:(__DQ.state().player&&__DQ.state().player.speed)||0}; return JSON.stringify({still0:window.__still0,still1:window.__still1}); })()

steps.msg: hero is standing still for the idle measure
standing still: follower walked almost nothing
standing still: hop rate is idle-only, not a wall-clock bounce

steps.note: 2. Walk — walked accumulates; sample hop rate mid-stride.

steps.eval: (async()=>{ const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); const mon=()=>(__DQ.state().companions.followers||[]).find(f=>f.kind==='monster')||(__DQ.state().companions.followers||[])[0]; const a=mon(); window.__walk0={walked:a&&a.walked, hops:a&&a.hops, rate:a&&a.rate}; let peak=0, leanPeak=0; __DQ.hold('up', 2000); for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ await sleep(160); const b=mon(); if(b){ peak=Math.max(peak, b.rate||0); leanPeak=Math.max(leanPeak, Math.abs(b.lean||0)); } } const c=mon(); window.__walk1={walked:c&&c.walked, hops:c&&c.hops, rate:c&&c.rate, lean:c&&c.lean, peak, leanPeak}; return JSON.stringify({walk0:window.__walk0,walk1:window.__walk1}); })()

steps.msg: walking: follower walked accumulates with trail distance
walking: hop count rises with distance (not wall clock)
mid-stride: hop rate or lean rises above idle
